reports.headline: Traveler Steps Off the Cliffs and Is Found at the Top
reports.body: {name} was seen to step off the cliffs {dir} of the village {dist}. The same traveler was found an hour later sitting at the top of the same cliff, unhurt, insisting {they} had fallen for a very long time. The edge is the same distance from the road it always was, but people who measure it keep getting different numbers.

reports.headline: The Cliff Edge Keeps Moving
reports.body: Shepherds say the cliffs {dir} of here {dist} are closer to the road every morning, then further again by night. {name} jumped from the edge on a dare and says {they} landed back where {they} started. Since the watchtower business began, nobody trusts a distance any more.
